Neither — they weigh exactly the same! A kilogram is a kilogram, regardless of the material.

This is a classic trick question that plays on our intuition. We associate feathers with lightness and steel with heaviness, so our gut says steel must be heavier. But weight is determined by mass, and both have exactly one kilogram of it.
